pkgTitle: Certificate derivative check at very small or zero flows (merged)
title: Accept ADR 0073: the derivative check at small and dormant flows
body: The certificate's finite-difference check of the Jacobian now refines its step where the registered step leaves the domain or is dominated by truncation, and steps one-sided at held-zero sides. No certificate that passed before changed; former spurious failures became honest verdicts. Merged on its default.
